name: io.github.ESAW381/chess-move-finder
title: Chess Move Finder
description: Stockfish 17.1 chess engine for AI assistants: best moves, FEN checks, legal moves, move lists.

tools.name: find_best_move
tools.description: Runs Stockfish 17.1 on a chess position and returns the best move (or top 2–3 moves), the evaluation, search depth and the expected continuation in standard notation.

fen.description: Position in FEN notation, e.g. "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1". Omit for the starting position.

think_time_ms.description: How long Stockfish searches, in milliseconds (300–3000, default 1500). Longer searches are deeper.

lines.description: How many candidate moves to return, best first (1–3, default 1).

tools.name: describe_position
tools.description: Validates a FEN and describes the position: side to move, check/checkmate/stalemate/draw status, material count, number of legal moves and a text diagram of the board.

fen.description: Position in FEN notation, e.g. "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1". Omit for the starting position.

tools.name: legal_moves
tools.description: Lists every legal move in a position, in standard notation (SAN) and UCI, optionally only for the piece on one square. Use it to check whether a move is legal.

fen.description: Position in FEN notation, e.g. "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1". Omit for the starting position.

square.description: Only list moves for the piece on this square, e.g. "g1".

tools.name: apply_moves
tools.description: Plays a sequence of moves (SAN like "Nf3" or UCI like "g1f3") from a position, checking each one is legal, and returns the resulting FEN and game status. Use it to turn a move list into a position.

fen.description: Position in FEN notation, e.g. "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1". Omit for the starting position.
